sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under hot, CometChat is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 10 category signals and 6 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask CometChat for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
sections.body: The strongest signal in this assessment is audience fit; the area requiring the most buyer diligence is product clarity. These signals describe documentation quality and should not be read as measured product performance.
